title: Untargeted serum and cerebrospinal fluid metabolomics of apparently healthy rabies virus-positive dogs in Nigeria.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Rabies remains a neglected zoonotic disease of global public health importance because of its near-universal fatality, limited reliable antemortem diagnostic options, and absence of effective treatment following the onset of clinical signs. However, metabolic alterations in dogs that are rabies-positive but show no observable clinical signs remain poorly characterized. Therefore, this study aimed to identify differentially abundant metabolites in apparently clinically healthy, direct fluorescent antibody (DFA)-positive dogs compared with DFA-negative dogs. METHODOLOGY: Samples comprising brain tissue, serum, and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) were collected from 231 apparently clinically healthy dogs. Rabies virus antigen was detected in brain tissue using the direct fluorescent antibody (DFA) test, and dogs were classified as rabies-positive or negative based on the results. Metabolites were extracted from serum and CSF using a validated sample preparation procedure for untargeted metabolomics. Metabolomic profiling was performed using comprehensive two-dimensional gas chromatography coupled with time-of-flight mass spectrometry (GC×GC-TOFMS) under optimized analytical conditions. RESULTS: Rabies virus antigen was detected in 20 of 231 brain tissue samples (8.7%). Corresponding serum and CSF samples were classified as rabies (DFA)-positive, while 20 negative samples were selected for comparison. After quality control, 868 serum and 300 CSF compounds were retained. Neither principal component analysis nor partial least squares discriminant analysis separated the groups in either matrix. Four serum features remained significant after false discovery rate (FDR) correction: Analyte 634, glyceric acid and Analyte 706 were lower, and benzoic acid was higher, in DFA-positive dogs. Analyte 634 gave the highest discovery-set area under the curve (AUC = 0.9575). In CSF, one unannotated feature (Analyte 369) was lower in DFA-positive dogs after FDR correction. Serum Analyte 634 and CSF Analyte 369 share retention times and mass spectra and may be the same compound. The serum pathways with the lowest enrichment p-values were mapped mainly by glyceric acid alone, and no CSF pathway remained significant after FDR correction. Indolelactic acid was higher in DFA-positive dogs in both matrices at the nominal level only. CONCLUSION: Four serum features and one CSF feature differed between apparently healthy DFA-positive and DFA-negative dogs after FDR correction. These are discovery-stage candidate features that require structural confirmation, targeted quantification and validation in an independent cohort before any diagnostic claim can be made.

source_records.abstract: Abstract Introduction : Rabies remains a neglected zoonotic disease of global public health importance due to its near-universal fatality, lack of reliable preclinical diagnostics, and absence of effective treatment after symptom onset. Methodology : This study investigated early metabolic alterations associated with rabies virus infection by profiling serum and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) metabolites in naturally infected dogs during the incubation phase. A total of 231 samples (brain tissue, serum, and CSF) were obtained from dogs slaughtered for human consumption in southeastern and north-central Nigeria. Results : Rabies antigen was detected in brain tissues using the direct fluorescent antibody test, identifying 20 positive cases (8.7%). Corresponding serum and CSF samples were classified as rabies-positive, while 20 negative samples were selected for comparison. Untargeted metabolomic analysis was performed using comprehensive two-dimensional gas chromatography coupled with time-of-flight mass spectrometry (GC×GC-TOFMS). Data processing included contaminant removal, normalization, batch correction, and scaling, followed by multivariate, univariate, pathway enrichment, and ROC analyses. The serum dataset yielded 868 retained compounds, while 300 compounds were retained from CSF after quality control. Missing data did not differ significantly between groups. Pathway analysis revealed significant perturbations in glycerolipid metabolism, glyoxylate and dicarboxylate metabolism, the pentose phosphate pathway, and amino acid metabolism in serum. Four serum metabolites remained significant after correction, with an unannotated compound (Analyte 634) showing strong discriminatory ability (AUC = 0.962). CSF analysis indicated enrichment in pentose phosphate, glutathione, and nicotinate metabolism. Indolelactic acid was consistently downregulated in both matrices. One shared metabolite was detected in serum and CSF. Conclusion : Overall, the findings demonstrate early metabolic disturbances during rabies infection and identify potential biomarkers for preclinical detection

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 狂犬病 仍然是一种对全球公共卫生具有重要意义的被忽视的人畜共患疾病,因为它几乎导致普遍死亡,可靠的生前诊断选择有限,并且在临床症状出现后缺乏有效的 治疗。然而,狂犬病 阳性但未表现出可观察到的临床症状的狗的代谢变化仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 从 231 只表面上临床健康的狗身上采集了包含脑组织、血清和脑脊液 (CSF) 的样本。相应的血清和脑脊液样本被归类为狂犬病(DFA)阳性,同时选择20个阴性样本进行比较。
elements_zh.methods: 使用直接荧光抗体(DFA)测试在脑组织中检测到狂犬病病毒抗原,并根据结果将狗分为狂犬病阳性或阴性。使用经过验证的非靶向代谢组学样品制备程序从血清和脑脊液中提取代谢物。在优化的分析条件下,使用综合二维气相色谱结合飞行时间质谱 (GC×GC-TOFMS) 进行代谢组学分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 231 个脑组织样本中,有 20 个(8.7%)检测到 狂犬病病毒 抗原。经过质量控制,保留了 868 种血清和 300 种脑脊液化合物。主成分分析和偏最小二乘判别分析都没有将任一矩阵中的组分开。错误发现率 (FDR) 校正后,四种血清特征仍然显着:DFA 阳性犬中分析物 634、甘油酸和分析物 706 较低,苯甲酸较高。分析物 634 给出了最高的曲线下发现集面积 (AUC = 0.9575)。在 CSF 中,经过 FDR 校正后,DFA 阳性狗的一项未注释特征(分析物 369)较低。血清分析物 634 和脑脊液分析物 369 具有相同的保留时间和质谱图,并且可能是相同的化合物。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: FDR 校正后,表面健康的 DFA 阳性狗和 DFA 阴性狗之间的四种血清特征和一种脑脊液特征存在差异。这些是发现阶段的候选特征,需要在独立的 队列研究 中进行结构确认、有针对性的量化和验证,然后才能做出任何诊断声明。

title_zh: 尼日利亚表面健康的 狂犬病病毒 阳性狗的非靶向血清和脑脊液代谢组学。
source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: Rabies remains a neglected zoonotic disease of global public health importance because of its near-universal fatality, limited reliable antemortem diagnostic options, and absence of effective treatment following the onset of clinical signs. However, metabolic alterations in dogs that are rabies-positive but show no observable clinical signs remain poorly characterized. Therefore, this study aimed to identify differentially abundant metabolites in apparently clinically healthy, direct fluorescent antibody (DFA)-positive dogs compared with DFA-negative dogs. METHODOLOGY: Samples comprising brain tissue, serum, and cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) were collected from 231 apparently clinically healthy dogs. Rabies virus antigen was detected in brain tissue using the direct fluorescent antibody (DFA) test, and dogs were classified as rabies-positive or negative based on the results. Metabolites were extracted from serum and CSF using a validated sample preparation procedure for untargeted metabolomics. Metabolomic profiling was performed using comprehensive two-dimensional gas chromatography coupled with time-of-flight mass spectrometry (GC×GC-TOFMS) under optimized analytical conditions. RESULTS: Rabies virus antigen was detected in 20 of 231 brain tissue samples (8.7%). Corresponding serum and CSF samples were classified as rabies (DFA)-positive, while 20 negative samples were selected for comparison. After quality control, 868 serum and 300 CSF compounds were retained. Neither principal component analysis nor partial least squares discriminant analysis separated the groups in either matrix. Four serum features remained significant after false discovery rate (FDR) correction: Analyte 634, glyceric acid and Analyte 706 were lower, and benzoic acid was higher, in DFA-positive dogs. Analyte 634 gave the highest discovery-set area under the curve (AUC = 0.9575). In CSF, one unannotated feature (Analyte 369) was lower in DFA-positive dogs after FDR correction. Serum Analyte 634 and CSF Analyte 369 share retention times and mass spectra and may be the same compound. The serum pathways with the lowest enrichment p-values were mapped mainly by glyceric acid alone, and no CSF pathway remained significant after FDR correction. Indolelactic acid was higher in DFA-positive dogs in both matrices at the nominal level only. CONCLUSION: Four serum features and one CSF feature differed between apparently healthy DFA-positive and DFA-negative dogs after FDR correction. These are discovery-stage candidate features that require structural confirmation, targeted quantification and validation in an independent cohort before any diagnostic claim can be made.
abstract_zh: 简介:狂犬病 仍然是一种对全球公共卫生具有重要意义的被忽视的人畜共患疾病,因为它几乎导致普遍死亡,可靠的生前诊断选择有限,并且在临床症状出现后缺乏有效的 治疗。然而,狂犬病 阳性但未表现出可观察到的临床症状的狗的代谢变化仍不清楚。因此,本研究旨在鉴定临床上健康的直接荧光抗体 (DFA) 阳性狗与 DFA 阴性狗中代谢物的丰度差异。方法:从 231 只表面上临床健康的狗身上采集包含脑组织、血清和脑脊液 (CSF) 的样本。使用直接荧光抗体(DFA)测试在脑组织中检测到狂犬病病毒抗原,并根据结果将狗分为狂犬病阳性或阴性。使用经过验证的非靶向代谢组学样品制备程序从血清和脑脊液中提取代谢物。在优化的分析条件下,使用综合二维气相色谱结合飞行时间质谱 (GC×GC-TOFMS) 进行代谢组学分析。结果:231 份脑组织样本中有 20 份检测到 狂犬病病毒 抗原(8.7%)。相应的血清和脑脊液样本被归类为狂犬病(DFA)阳性,同时选择20个阴性样本进行比较。经过质量控制,保留了 868 种血清和 300 种脑脊液化合物。主成分分析和偏最小二乘判别分析都没有将任一矩阵中的组分开。错误发现率 (FDR) 校正后,四种血清特征仍然显着:DFA 阳性犬中分析物 634、甘油酸和分析物 706 较低,苯甲酸较高。分析物 634 给出了最高的曲线下发现集面积 (AUC = 0.9575)。在 CSF 中,经过 FDR 校正后,DFA 阳性狗的一项未注释特征(分析物 369)较低。血清分析物 634 和脑脊液分析物 369 具有相同的保留时间和质谱图,并且可能是相同的化合物。具有最低富集 p 值的血清通路主要由单独的甘油绘制,并且在 FDR 校正后没有 CSF 通路仍然显着。在两种基质中,DFA 阳性狗的吲哚乳酸均较高,仅达到标称水平。结论:FDR 校正后,表面健康的 DFA 阳性和 DFA 阴性犬之间的 4 项血清特征和 1 项脑脊液特征存在差异。这些是发现阶段的候选特征,需要在独立的 队列研究 中进行结构确认、有针对性的量化和验证,然后才能做出任何诊断声明。

title: Rapid competitive ELISA incorporating Semliki Forest virus-expressed rabies virus glycoprotein for serological surveillance of canine and feline rabies immunity.
abstract: Although the case fatality rate of rabies approaches 100%, it is entirely preventable through the use of vaccination-induced neutralizing antibodies. Rapid and reliable detection of these antibodies is therefore critical for effective disease control. Using a rabies virus glycoprotein expressed by Semliki Forest virus (SFV-RVG) as a coating antigen and horseradish peroxidase-labeled 7A3 (HRP-7A3) as the detection antibody, we developed a competitive ELISA (cELISA) for the specific detection of rabies virus glycoprotein (RVG)-neutralizing antibodies. On the basis of the testing of the in-house sample panel, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis revealed optimal cutoff values of 42.5% for canine serum and 54.5% for feline serum. The clinical agreement of the kit was excellent, with an overall percent agreement (OPA) of 95.67% for canine serum and 97.17% for feline serum. Overall, the cELISA reported here provides a promising tool for rabies immune surveillance in dogs and cats.

title_zh: 快速竞争性 ELISA,结合塞姆利基森林病毒表达的 狂犬病病毒 糖蛋白,用于犬和猫 狂犬病 免疫的血清学 监测。

Rapid and reliable detection of these antibodies is therefore critical for effective disease control. On the basis of the testing of the in-house sample panel, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve analysis revealed optimal cutoff values of 42.5% for canine serum and 54.5% for feline serum. The clinical agreement of the kit was excellent, with an overall percent agreement (OPA) of 95.67% for canine serum and 97.17% for feline serum. Overall, the cELISA reported here provides a promising tool for rabies immune surveillance in dogs and cats.

title: Development and validation of a real-time PCR assay for the detection of SEA4 clade rabies virus (Philippine strain) in post-mortem non-brain animal samples.
abstract: Rabies remains a major public health concern in endemic settings, where effective control depends on timely and reliable post-mortem confirmation of infection in animal reservoirs. Although the direct fluorescent antibody test (dFAT) remains the reference standard, its dependence on fresh brain tissue and susceptibility to specimen degradation limits its operational use in decentralized surveillance systems. The present findings demonstrate that the locally optimized RT-qPCR assay targeting the nucleoprotein gene in non-brain tissues exhibits high analytical sensitivity and strong concordance with dFAT results obtained from post-mortem brain specimens of dogs. The consistent performance in nasal planum and follicle-sinus complex samples supports using safer, more accessible post-mortem specimens, reinforcing the potential for scalable, field-adapted molecular diagnostics to strengthen routine animal rabies surveillance in endemic regions.

title: Molecular characterization of rabies virus in Eritrea reveals circulation of the Africa 1a lineage.
abstract: Rabies remains endemic in many parts of Africa, yet molecular data from several countries, including Eritrea, are lacking. This study reports the first molecular characterization of rabies virus (RABV) in Eritrea using archived brain samples collected between 2001 and 2024. A total of 95 samples from domestic and wild animals were screened using one-step RT-PCR targeting the nucleoprotein (N) gene. Eighteen samples tested positive, of which sixteen yielded sequences of sufficient quality for phylogenetic analysis. Maximum likelihood analysis revealed that all Eritrean RABV sequences clustered within the Africa 1a lineage and showed close genetic relatedness to strains from Ethiopia and Somalia, indicating regional connectivity and probable cross-border transmission. Sequences from different host species and regions were interspersed within the phylogeny, supporting domestic dogs as the primary reservoir with frequent spillover into livestock. Although Eritrea has implemented periodic mass dog vaccination campaigns, the continued circulation of genetically related RABV strains highlights gaps in surveillance and control. These findings provide a critical molecular baseline for rabies in Eritrea and support the need for sustained dog vaccination and strengthened regional surveillance to advance rabies elimination efforts.

title_zh: 厄立特里亚 狂犬病病毒 的分子表征揭示了 Africa 1a 谱系的循环。
source_body_en: Rabies remains endemic in many parts of Africa, yet molecular data from several countries, including Eritrea, are lacking. This study reports the first molecular characterization of rabies virus (RABV) in Eritrea using archived brain samples collected between 2001 and 2024. A total of 95 samples from domestic and wild animals were screened using one-step RT-PCR targeting the nucleoprotein (N) gene. Eighteen samples tested positive, of which sixteen yielded sequences of sufficient quality for phylogenetic analysis. Maximum likelihood analysis revealed that all Eritrean RABV sequences clustered within the Africa 1a lineage and showed close genetic relatedness to strains from Ethiopia and Somalia, indicating regional connectivity and probable cross-border transmission. Sequences from different host species and regions were interspersed within the phylogeny, supporting domestic dogs as the primary reservoir with frequent spillover into livestock. Although Eritrea has implemented periodic mass dog vaccination campaigns, the continued circulation of genetically related RABV strains highlights gaps in surveillance and control. These findings provide a critical molecular baseline for rabies in Eritrea and support the need for sustained dog vaccination and strengthened regional surveillance to advance rabies elimination efforts.
abstract_zh: 狂犬病 在非洲许多地区仍然流行,但缺乏包括厄立特里亚在内的几个国家的分子数据。本研究报告了厄立特里亚使用 2001 年至 2024 年间收集的存档脑样本首次对 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 进行分子表征。使用针对核蛋白 (N) 基因的一步 RT-PCR 对来自家养和野生动物的总共 95 个样本进行了筛选。十八个样本测试呈阳性,其中十六个产生的序列质量足以进行系统发育分析。最大似然分析显示,所有厄立特里亚 RABV 序列都聚集在 Africa 1a 谱系内,并显示出与埃塞俄比亚和索马里毒株的密切遗传相关性,表明区域连通性和可能的​​跨境 传播。来自不同 宿主 物种和区域的序列散布在 系统发育 内,支持家犬作为主要 储存宿主,而频繁的 跨物种溢出 进入牲畜。尽管厄立特里亚定期开展大规模犬疫苗接种运动,但遗传相关RABV毒株的持续传播凸显了监测和控制方面的差距。这些发现为厄立特里亚的 狂犬病 提供了关键的分子基线,并支持需要持续狗 疫苗接种 和加强区域 狂犬病 以推进 狂犬病 消除工作。

title: Recent Advances in Rabies Virus Genomics with Special Emphasis on Immunogenic Glycoprotein Ectodomain: Structure, Evolution, and Intervention Implications
abstract: Rabies remains an invariably fatal encephalitis claiming approximately 59,000 human lives annually, with the burden concentrated in low- and middle-income countries of Asia and Africa. Prevention depends almost exclusively upon vaccination and post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) regimens that elicit virus-neutralizing antibodies directed against the viral glycoprotein (G). This review synthesizes recent advances in rabies virus (RABV) genomics and structural virology with particular emphasis upon the G ectodomain, the sole surface-exposed viral component and the primary immunological target of protective immunity. This review examines the RABV evolution across phylogenetically distinct lyssavirus lineages, the molecular determinants of virulence and neuroinvasiveness encoded within the G gene, and structural characterization of the ectodomain by contemporary cryo-electron microscopy and crystallography. High-resolution structural studies have resolved the quaternary organization of the prefusion trimer engaged by neutralizing antibodies, indicating that the conformational stability of these epitopes is an important determinant of vaccine-induced immunity, and cryo-electron microscopy of nine antibody complexes reported in 2026 has extended the antigenic map to six sites, two of them newly defined, unusually well conserved across lyssaviruses and recognized by the most broadly cross-reactive antibodies yet described. The applied literature is then organized around the three translational uses of the protein: its diagnostic application in ectodomain-based serology and antigen detection, its therapeutic application in monoclonal antibody cocktails replacing serum-derived immunoglobulin, and its vaccinal application across inactivated, subunit, virus-like particle, vectored, and nucleic acid platforms. Ectodomain architecture therefore underpins next-generation vaccines, improved post-exposure therapeutics and diagnostics, and with them the global target of zero human deaths from dog-mediated rabies by 2030.

abstract_zh: 狂犬病 仍然是一种致命的脑炎,每年夺去约 59,000 人的生命,负担集中在亚洲和非洲的低收入和中等收入国家。预防几乎完全依赖于 疫苗接种 和 暴露后预防 (PEP) 方案,这些方案可引发针对病毒糖蛋白 (G) 的病毒中和抗体。本综述综合了 狂犬病病毒 (RABV) 基因组学和结构病毒学的最新进展,特别强调 G 胞外域、唯一的表面暴露病毒成分和保护性免疫的主要免疫学靶点。这篇综述研究了 RABV 进化 跨越系统发育上不同的狂犬病病毒谱系、G 基因内编码的毒力和神经侵袭性的分子决定因素,以及通过当代冷冻电子显微镜和晶体学对胞外域的结构表征。高分辨率结构研究已经解析了中和抗体参与的融合前三聚体的四级组织,表明这些表位的构象稳定性是 疫苗 诱导免疫的重要决定因素,2026 年报道的九种抗体复合物的冷冻电子显微镜将抗原图谱扩展到了 6 个位点,其中两个是新定义的,在狂犬病毒中异常保守,并被最广泛的交叉反应抗体识别尚未描述。然后,应用文献围绕该蛋白质的三种转化用途进行组织:其在基于胞外域的 血清学 和抗原检测中的诊断应用,其在替代血清源免疫球蛋白的单克隆抗体混合物中的治疗应用,以及其在灭活、亚基、病毒样颗粒、载体和核酸平台上的疫苗应用。因此,胞外域结构支撑了下一代 疫苗、改进的暴露后治疗和诊断,并由此实现到 2030 年狗介导的 狂犬病 人类零死亡的全球目标。

title: Detection of Rabies Virus Antigen by Fluorescent Antibody Test and Rapid Immunochromatographic Assay in a Pregnant Goat from Salem, Tamil Nadu, India
abstract: Rabies in small ruminants is underdiagnosed in India because a bite history is often absent and clinical signs may mimic metabolic disorders of late pregnancy. This study reports a case of rabies in a pregnant doe, confirmed by the fluorescent antibody test and supported by two complementary techniques. A doe at approximately 4.5 months’ gestation was presented to the Veterinary Clinical Complex, Veterinary College and Research Institute, Salem, Tamil Nadu, with inappetence, aggression and recumbency. Blood and urine glucose were estimated ante-mortem. The doe exhibited aggression, biting, eye rubbing, continuous leg licking, yawning, bleating and sternal recumbency, with no reported history of a dog bite. The doe died on the day of presentation. Blood glucose was 103 mg/dL, accompanied by glucosuria. Postmortem brain tissue collected through the occipital foramen was examined using the fluorescent antibody test (FAT), a rapid immunochromatographic lateral flow assay (LFA) and modified Van Gieson staining. FAT revealed apple-green intracytoplasmic fluorescence, the LFA showed distinct control and test bands and Negri bodies were identified by modified Van Gieson staining. Rabies was confirmed by FAT; the LFA result was concordant and the Negri bodies provided supportive evidence. Hyperglycaemia with glucosuria in an anorectic pregnant doe was observed in this case; however, this finding is non-specific, and its diagnostic value needs to be evaluated in a larger number of cases. The LFA offers rapid, field-level detection and can complement FAT, the gold standard method.
journal: Asian Journal of Microbiology and Biotechnology

abstract_zh: 在印度,小反刍动物的 狂犬病 诊断不足,因为通常没有咬伤史,而且临床症状可能类似于妊娠晚期的代谢紊乱。本研究报告了怀孕母鹿中 狂犬病 的病例,经荧光抗体测试证实并得到两种互补技术的支持。一只妊娠约 4.5 个月的母鹿被送往泰米尔纳德邦塞勒姆兽医学院和研究所兽医临床中心,其食欲不振、攻击性强且躺着。生前估计血糖和尿糖。母鹿表现出攻击性、咬人、揉眼睛、连续舔腿、打哈欠、咩咩叫和胸骨躺卧,没有被狗咬伤的报道。母鹿在介绍当天就死了。血糖为103 mg/dL,伴有糖尿。使用荧光抗体测试(FAT)、快速免疫层析侧流测定(LFA)和改良的范吉森染色对通过枕大孔收集的死后脑组织进行检查。FAT 显示苹果绿胞质内荧光,LFA 显示明显的对照带和测试带,并通过改良的 Van Gieson 染色鉴定 Negri 小体。狂犬病被FAT确认;LFA 结果一致,Negri 机构提供了支持性证据。在本例中观察到一只厌食的怀孕母鹿出现高血糖并伴有糖尿。然而,这一发现并不具有特异性,其诊断价值需要在更多病例中进行评估。LFA 提供快速的现场级检测,可以补充 FAT(黄金标准方法)。

analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 狂犬病被FAT确认;LFA 结果一致,Negri 机构提供了支持性证据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: LFA 提供快速的现场级检测,可以补充 FAT(黄金标准方法)。

title: After the bite: A descriptive analysis of animal exposure incidents resulting in a human rabies post-exposure prophylaxis recommendation in Ontario, Canada, 2014–2024
abstract: Background: For all potential rabies exposure incidents in Ontario, Canada where rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (RPEP) is recommended, demographic and exposure information is reported to Public Health Ontario to support provincial surveillance of such incidents and to inform provincial planning, including vaccine procurement.Objective: To describe demographic and species-specific trends for potential rabies exposures of Ontario residents, either locally or overseas, that resulted in a recommendation to receive RPEP.Findings can inform public education and public health risk assessments.Methods: Demographic and exposure information for Ontario residents who were recommended to receive RPEP from 2014 to 2024 were extracted from the provincial surveillance database.Publicly available animal rabies testing data from the Canadian Food Inspection Agency were obtained for the same period.Data were analyzed to identify demographic or species-specific trends.Results: Reported potential rabies exposure incidents more than doubled over the study period.Most incidents involved a dog (37%), bat (22%) or a cat (17%), with bat exposures consistently peaking during the month of August.Implicated animal species was associated with both client age and gender.Sixteen percent of incidents involving international travel were associated with a primate, several with a macaque.Conclusion: Increasing awareness among pet owners about the importance of rabies vaccination for domestic cats and dogs, and the need to share such information in the event of a potential exposure incident, could mitigate the need for RPEP in some situations.Risk assessment for returning travellers who report an exposure incident involving a primate should consider other zoonotic exposure risks, particularly herpes B virus.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to describe demographic and species-specific trends for potential rabies exposures of Ontario residents that resulted in a recommendation to receive rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (RPEP). This is important for informing public education and public health risk assessments.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed demographic and exposure information for Ontario residents recommended to receive RPEP from 2014 to 2024, extracted from the provincial surveillance database. Publicly available animal rabies testing data from the Canadian Food Inspection Agency were also obtained for the same period.
analysis.methods: Demographic and exposure information for Ontario residents who were recommended to receive RPEP was extracted from the provincial surveillance database. Publicly available animal rabies testing data from the Canadian Food Inspection Agency were obtained for the same period and analyzed to identify demographic or species-specific trends.
analysis.main_results: Reported potential rabies exposure incidents more than doubled over the study period. Most incidents involved a dog (37%), bat (22%) or a cat (17%), with bat exposures consistently peaking during the month of August. Implicated animal species was associated with both client age and gender. Sixteen percent of incidents involving international travel were associated with a primate, several with a macaque.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors suggest that increasing awareness among pet owners about the importance of rabies vaccination for domestic cats and dogs, and the need to share such information in the event of a potential exposure incident, could mitigate the need for RPEP in some situations. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform public education efforts and public health risk assessments, particularly regarding the prevention of rabies exposure through pet vaccination and the management of zoonotic risks for returning travelers.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted a descriptive analysis of animal exposure incidents in Ontario, Canada, from 2014 to 2024 that resulted in a recommendation for rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (RPEP). It aimed to identify demographic and species-specific trends in rabies exposure incidents to support public health planning and risk assessments. The researchers extracted data from the provincial surveillance database and used publicly available animal rabies testing data. The results showed that reported rabies exposure incidents more than doubled during the study period, with dogs, bats, and cats being the most commonly implicated animals. Bat exposures peaked in August, and animal species were associated with client age and gender. International travel was linked to primate exposures, with macaques being a notable species. The authors suggest that increasing awareness about pet rabies vaccination and sharing this information could reduce the need for RPEP. They also emphasize the importance of considering other zoonotic risks for travelers exposed to primates. The study's findings are based on observational data, which limits the strength of the evidence to moderate.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在描述安大略省居民潜在 狂犬病 暴露的人口统计和物种特定趋势,从而建议接受 狂犬病 暴露后预防 (RPEP)。这对于为公众教育和公共卫生风险评估提供信息非常重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了从省 监测 数据库中提取的 2014 年至 2024 年建议接受 RPEP 的安大略省居民的人口统计和暴露信息。同期还获得了加拿大食品检验局公开的动物 狂犬病 检测数据。
elements_zh.methods: 建议接受 RPEP 的安大略省居民的人口统计和暴露信息是从省 监测 数据库中提取的。来自加拿大食品检验局的公开动物 狂犬病 测试数据是在同一时期获得的,并进行分析以确定人口或物种特定的趋势。
elements_zh.main_results: 研究期间报告的潜在 狂犬病 暴露事件增加了一倍多。大多数事件涉及狗(37%)、蝙蝠(22%)或猫(17%),其中蝙蝠接触率在八月份持续达到峰值。涉及的动物种类与客户的年龄和性别相关。百分之十六涉及国际旅行的事件与灵长类动物有关,其中几起与猕猴有关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者建议,提高宠物主人对 狂犬病 疫苗接种 对于家猫和狗的重要性的认识,以及在发生潜在暴露事件时分享此类信息的必要性,可以减轻在某些情况下对 RPEP 的需求。他们还强调,考虑到其他人畜共患病暴露风险,需要对报告涉及灵长类动物的暴露事件的回国旅行者进行风险评估。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为公共教育工作和公共卫生风险评估提供信息,特别是在通过宠物 狂犬病 预防 狂犬病 暴露以及回程旅行者人畜共患病风险管理方面。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于省级 监测 系统报告的数据,该系统可能存在漏报或数据收集实践存在差异的情况。由于依赖观察数据而不是实验方法,证据的强度中等。

source_body_en: Background: For all potential rabies exposure incidents in Ontario, Canada where rabies post-exposure prophylaxis (RPEP) is recommended, demographic and exposure information is reported to Public Health Ontario to support provincial surveillance of such incidents and to inform provincial planning, including vaccine procurement.Objective: To describe demographic and species-specific trends for potential rabies exposures of Ontario residents, either locally or overseas, that resulted in a recommendation to receive RPEP.Findings can inform public education and public health risk assessments.Methods: Demographic and exposure information for Ontario residents who were recommended to receive RPEP from 2014 to 2024 were extracted from the provincial surveillance database.Publicly available animal rabies testing data from the Canadian Food Inspection Agency were obtained for the same period.Data were analyzed to identify demographic or species-specific trends.Results: Reported potential rabies exposure incidents more than doubled over the study period.Most incidents involved a dog (37%), bat (22%) or a cat (17%), with bat exposures consistently peaking during the month of August.Implicated animal species was associated with both client age and gender.Sixteen percent of incidents involving international travel were associated with a primate, several with a macaque.Conclusion: Increasing awareness among pet owners about the importance of rabies vaccination for domestic cats and dogs, and the need to share such information in the event of a potential exposure incident, could mitigate the need for RPEP in some situations.Risk assessment for returning travellers who report an exposure incident involving a primate should consider other zoonotic exposure risks, particularly herpes B virus.
abstract_zh: 背景:对于加拿大安大略省建议 狂犬病 暴露后预防 (RPEP) 的所有潜在 狂犬病 暴露事件,人口统计和暴露信息将报告给安大略省公共卫生部门,以支持省 狂犬病 处理此类事件,并为省级规划(包括 疫苗 采购)提供信息。目标:描述安大略省本地或当地居民潜在 狂犬病 暴露的人口和物种特定趋势研究结果可以为公共教育和公共卫生风险评估提供信息。方法:从省级 监测 数据库中提取 2014 年至 2024 年建议接受 RPEP 的安大略省居民的人口统计和暴露信息。获得了加拿大食品检验局同期公开的动物 狂犬病 检测数据。对数据进行分析,以确定人口或物种特定趋势。结果:研究期间报告的潜在 狂犬病 暴露事件增加了一倍多。大多数事件涉及狗 (37%)、蝙蝠 (22%) 或猫 (17%),其中蝙蝠暴露在 8 月份持续达到峰值。涉及的动物种类与客户年龄和性别有关。涉及国际旅行的事件中,有 16% 与灵长类动物有关,其中几例与猕猴有关。结论:宠物主人越来越认识到 狂犬病 的重要性。针对家猫和狗的 狂犬病 疫苗接种,以及在发生潜在暴露事件时共享此类信息的需要,可以在某些情况下减轻 RPEP 的需求。对报告涉及灵长类动物的暴露事件的回国旅行者进行风险评估,应考虑其他人畜共患暴露风险,特别是 B 型疱疹病毒。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在描述安大略省居民潜在 狂犬病 暴露的人口统计和物种特定趋势,从而建议接受 狂犬病 暴露后预防 (RPEP)。这对于为公众教育和公共卫生风险评估提供信息非常重要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了从省 监测 数据库中提取的 2014 年至 2024 年建议接受 RPEP 的安大略省居民的人口统计和暴露信息。同期还获得了加拿大食品检验局公开的动物 狂犬病 检测数据。
analysis_zh.methods: 建议接受 RPEP 的安大略省居民的人口统计和暴露信息是从省 监测 数据库中提取的。来自加拿大食品检验局的公开动物 狂犬病 测试数据是在同一时期获得的,并进行分析以确定人口或物种特定的趋势。
analysis_zh.main_results: 研究期间报告的潜在 狂犬病 暴露事件增加了一倍多。大多数事件涉及狗(37%)、蝙蝠(22%)或猫(17%),其中蝙蝠接触率在八月份持续达到峰值。涉及的动物种类与客户的年龄和性别相关。百分之十六涉及国际旅行的事件与灵长类动物有关,其中几起与猕猴有关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者建议,提高宠物主人对 狂犬病 疫苗接种 对于家猫和狗的重要性的认识,以及在发生潜在暴露事件时分享此类信息的必要性,可以减轻在某些情况下对 RPEP 的需求。他们还强调,考虑到其他人畜共患病暴露风险,需要对报告涉及灵长类动物的暴露事件的回国旅行者进行风险评估。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可为公共教育工作和公共卫生风险评估提供信息,特别是在通过宠物 狂犬病 预防 狂犬病 暴露以及回程旅行者人畜共患病风险管理方面。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于省级 监测 系统报告的数据,该系统可能存在漏报或数据收集实践存在差异的情况。由于依赖观察数据而不是实验方法,证据的强度中等。

title: Unified Command in Local Public Health: Case Studies of Rabies and Tuberculosis Responses in Douglas County, Nebraska.
abstract: As public health emergencies become more frequent and complex, local health departments must increasingly rely on public-private partnerships and whole-community approaches to respond effectively. The Douglas County Health Department (DCHD), serving Nebraska's most populous county, demonstrates how a local agency can coordinate large-scale responses by implementing a unified command structure with diverse partners. This case study presents 2 concurrent public health emergencies that occurred in late 2023: (1) the detection of raccoon rabies virus variant (RRVV) in a domestic kitten, a pathogen not previously identified in Nebraska, and (2) the largest pediatric tuberculosis (TB) exposure investigated in the county's history. Both incidents required rapid coordination across local, state, and federal agencies, as well as engagement with healthcare systems and community organizations. In each response, DCHD activated a unified command structure to facilitate operational objectives, allocate resources, and coordinate risk communication. The rabies response included enhanced animal surveillance, a trap-vaccinate-release campaign, and the manual distribution of 18,000 oral rabies vaccine baits. No additional human or animal cases of RRVV were identified. The TB response involved identifying 643 exposed individuals, conducting mass testing clinics with local healthcare partners, and rapidly initiating prophylaxis for vulnerable populations. No cases of secondary transmission were identified. These case studies demonstrate how local health departments can lead complex responses by leveraging established partnerships, aligning with National Incident Management System principles, and coordinating unified command operations. Lessons learned from Douglas County's experience offer practical guidance for other jurisdictions preparing for zoonotic and airborne infectious disease threats, especially when internal resources are limited.

abstract_zh: 随着突发公共卫生事件变得更加频繁和复杂,地方卫生部门必须越来越多地依靠公私伙伴关系和全社区方法来有效应对。为内布拉斯加州人口最多的县提供服务的道格拉斯县卫生局 (DCHD) 展示了当地机构如何通过与不同合作伙伴实施统一的指挥结构来协调大规模应对措施。本案例研究介绍了 2023 年末同时发生的 2 起突发公共卫生事件:(1) 在内布拉斯加州检测到浣熊 狂犬病病毒 变种 (RRVV),这是一种以前未在内布拉斯加州发现的病原体;(2) 该县历史上调查的最大规模的儿童结核病 (TB) 暴露事件。这两起事件都需要地方、州和联邦机构之间的快速协调,以及医疗系统和社区组织的参与。在每次响应中,DCHD 都启动了统一的指挥结构,以促进行动目标、分配资源并协调风险沟通。狂犬病 应对措施包括增强动物 狂犬病、诱捕-疫苗-释放活动以及手动分发 18,000 个口服 狂犬病 疫苗 诱饵。没有发现其他人类或动物 RRVV 病例。结核病应对措施包括识别 643 名暴露者、与当地医疗合作伙伴一起开展大规模诊所检测,并迅速启动针对弱势群体的预防措施。未发现继发性 传播 病例。这些案例研究展示了地方卫生部门如何通过利用已建立的伙伴关系、符合国家事件管理系统原则以及协调统一指挥行动来领导复杂的应对措施。从道格拉斯县的经验中吸取的教训为其他司法管辖区准备应对人畜共患和空气传播的传染病威胁提供了实用指导,特别是在内部资源有限的情况下。

title: A systematic review of prophylaxis practices after rabies exposure in Türkiye: a 14-year retrospective evaluation (2010–2024)
abstract: Abstract Background Rabies is a fatal viral zoonotic disease. Despite Türkiye’s integrated human, domestic animal, and wildlife vaccination programs alongside post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) services, human rabies cases continue to occur annually. Aim This review systematically examines the current state of Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (PEP) following suspected rabies exposure in Türkiye, evaluating rabies control practices and prophylaxis data from the literature. Method Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a descriptive evidence synthesis was conducted using data from 43 observational studies on rabies prophylaxis in Türkiye published between 2010 and 2024, retrieved from databases including PubMed, Web of Science, TR Dizin, and local repositories. Results All included studies were retrospective and reported 111,677 presentations; among the 110,094 individuals with available prophylaxis data, 92.5% received PEP. Contact with stray animals accounted for 67.8%, while contact with owned but unvaccinated animals was 18.3%. The 4-dose vaccine regimen was the most common, and rabies immunoglobulin (RIG) was administered in 36.2% of cases. Notably, 81.5% of individuals sought PEP within 24 h. Side effects, including fever, local swelling, and erythema, were reported in 3.84% of cases. Conclusion Although rabies control measures in Türkiye have achieved substantial progress, regional disparities in PEP administration remain evident. Observed variations in prophylaxis completion, delayed presentation (> 24 h), and inconsistent RIG administration highlight ongoing public health challenges. As the included studies did not directly assess the causes of these patterns, factors such as guideline adherence, public awareness, and regional service organization warrant further investigation. Continuous professional training, public health outreach, and stray animal population management may help optimize rabies prophylaxis strategies.

Aim This review systematically examines the current state of Post-Exposure Prophylaxis (PEP) following suspected rabies exposure in Türkiye, evaluating rabies control practices and prophylaxis data from the literature. Method Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, a descriptive evidence synthesis was conducted using data from 43 observational studies on rabies prophylaxis in Türkiye published between 2010 and 2024, retrieved from databases including PubMed, Web of Science, TR Dizin, and local repositories. Results All included studies were retrospective and reported 111,677 presentations; among the 110,094 individuals with available prophylaxis data, 92.5% received PEP. Contact with stray animals accounted for 67.8%, while contact with owned but unvaccinated animals was 18.3%. The 4-dose vaccine regimen was the most common, and rabies immunoglobulin (RIG) was administered in 36.2% of cases. Notably, 81.5% of individuals sought PEP within 24 h. Side effects, including fever, local swelling, and erythema, were reported in 3.84% of cases. Conclusion Although rabies control measures in Türkiye have achieved substantial progress, regional disparities in PEP administration remain evident. Observed variations in prophylaxis completion, delayed presentation (> 24 h), and inconsistent RIG administration highlight ongoing public health challenges. As the included studies did not directly assess the causes of these patterns, factors such as guideline adherence, public awareness, and regional service organization warrant further investigation. Continuous professional training, public health outreach, and stray animal population management may help optimize rabies prophylaxis strategies.

It analyzed 43 observational studies retrieved from PubMed, Web of Science, TR Dizin, and local repositories. The review found that 92.5% of individuals with available prophylaxis data received PEP, with 81.5% seeking it within 24 hours. Contact with stray animals was the most common source of exposure (67.8%), followed by owned but unvaccinated animals (18.3%). abstract_zh: 摘要背景 狂犬病 是一种致命的病毒性人畜共患疾病。尽管土耳其制定了综合人类、家畜和野生动物 疫苗接种 计划以及 暴露后预防 (PEP) 服务,但人类 狂犬病 病例每年仍然发生。目的 本综述系统地研究了土耳其疑似 狂犬病 暴露后 暴露后预防 (PEP) 的现状,评估了 狂犬病 控制实践和文献中的预防数据。方法 根据 PRISMA 2020 指南,使用 2010 年至 2024 年间在土耳其发表的 43 项关于 狂犬病 预防的观察性研究的数据进行了描述性证据综合,这些数据检索自 PubMed、Web of Science、TR Dizin 和本地存储库等数据库。结果 所有纳入的研究均为回顾性研究,报告了 111,677 份报告;在有可用预防数据的 110,094 人中,92.5% 接受了 PEP。与流浪动物接触的占67.8%,与自养但未接种疫苗的动物接触的占18.3%。4 剂 疫苗 方案是最常见的,36.2% 的病例使用了 狂犬病 免疫球蛋白 (RIG)。值得注意的是,81.5% 的人在 24 小时内寻求 PEP。3.84% 的病例报告了副作用,包括发烧、局部肿胀和红斑。结论 虽然土耳其的 狂犬病 管控措施取得了实质性进展,但 PEP 管理的地区差异仍然明显。观察到的预防完成情况的差异、延迟就诊(> 24 小时)和不一致的 RIG 管理凸显了持续的公共卫生挑战。由于纳入的研究没有直接评估这些模式的原因,因此指南遵守情况、公众意识和区域服务组织等因素值得进一步调查。持续的专业培训、公共卫生推广和流浪动物种群管理可能有助于优化 狂犬病 预防策略。

analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 所有纳入的研究均为回顾性研究,且92.5%的暴露后预防数据可获得者接受了暴露后预防(PEP)。接触流浪动物占病例的67.8%,而接触已拥有但未接种疫苗的动物占18.3%。4剂疫苗方案是最常见的方案,免疫球蛋白(RIG)在36.2%的病例中被使用。值得注意的是,81.5%的个体在24小时内寻求了PEP,且有3.84%的病例报告了不良反应。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 纳入的研究并未直接评估预防完成情况变化、延迟就诊(> 24 小时)和 RIG 给药不一致的原因。这些模式可能受到指南遵守情况、公众意识和区域服务组织等因素的影响,需要进一步调查。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 持续的专业培训、公共卫生推广和流浪动物种群管理可能有助于优化 狂犬病 预防策略。观察到的预防完成情况的差异、延迟就诊和 RIG 管理不一致凸显了持续的公共卫生挑战。

title: Heterogeneous Pathways to Rabies Prevention: Household-Level Determinants and Dog Owner Profiles of Vaccination Uptake
abstract: Abstract Dog-mediated rabies remains a persistent public health challenge in many low- and middle-income countries, despite the availability of effective vaccines and global commitments to eliminate the disease through mass dog vaccination. Achieving and sustaining the recommended 70% vaccination coverage is complicated by substantial heterogeneity in dog ownership, management practices, and access to veterinary services, across urban and rural settings. This study investigates household-level determinants of dog vaccination and explores heterogeneity in rabies knowledge and vaccination behaviour among dog-owning households in Mzimba District, Malawi. Using secondary cross-sectional survey data from 682 households, the study combines count data regression and latent class analysis to examine factors influencing the number of dogs vaccinated per household and to identify distinct dog-owner typologies. The Negative Binomial Regression results indicate that urban residence, higher educational attainment, training in responsible dog ownership, larger dog ownership size, and prior vaccination behaviour significantly increase household vaccination uptake, whereas rabies knowledge alone does not independently predict vaccination. Latent Class Analysis revealed three distinct owner profiles: low-awareness moderate-prevention owners, prevention-oriented moderately aware owners , and high-awareness high-risk multidog owners . These clusters differ markedly in dog population structure, knowledge levels, and vaccination outcomes, highlighting mismatches between awareness and practice in some groups. In summary, the findings demonstrate that household-level configurations and behavioural patterns play a critical role in shaping vaccination outcomes. Tailored, context-sensitive rabies control strategies that integrate education, behaviour-focused training, and structural support are essential to improve vaccination coverage and advance dog-mediated rabies elimination.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study uses secondary cross-sectional survey data from 682 households in Mzimba District, Malawi, to investigate household-level determinants of dog vaccination and explore heterogeneity in rabies knowledge and vaccination behaviour among dog-owning households.
analysis.methods: The study combines count data regression and latent class analysis to examine factors influencing the number of dogs vaccinated per household and to identify distinct dog-owner typologies.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the factors influencing dog vaccination uptake at the household level in Mzimba District, Malawi. It highlights the heterogeneity in rabies knowledge and vaccination behaviour among dog-owning households, identifying distinct owner profiles. The research demonstrates that urban residence, higher education, responsible dog ownership training, larger dog ownership size, and prior vaccination behaviour significantly increase vaccination rates. However, rabies knowledge alone does not independently predict vaccination. The study uses secondary cross-sectional survey data and combines count data regression with latent class analysis to uncover these patterns. The findings emphasize the importance of tailored, context-sensitive rabies control strategies that integrate education and structural support. The study's limitations include the complexity of achieving and sustaining the recommended 70% vaccination coverage due to variations in dog ownership and access to veterinary services across different settings. The evidence is moderate in strength, as it is based on observational data and does not establish causality.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管存在有效的 疫苗 且全球承诺通过大规模狗 疫苗 消除这种疾病,但本研究解决了低收入和中等收入国家由狗介导的 狂犬病 带来的持续公共卫生挑战。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用马拉维姆津巴区682户家庭的二次横断面调查数据,调查家庭层面养狗疫苗接种的决定因素,并探讨养狗家庭狂犬病知识和疫苗接种行为的异质性。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究结合了计数数据回归和潜在类别分析,以检查影响每个家庭接种疫苗的狗数量的因素,并确定不同的狗主人类型。
elements_zh.main_results: 负二项回归结果表明,城市居住、较高的教育程度、负责任养狗的培训、较大的养狗规模以及之前的 疫苗接种 行为显着增加了家庭 疫苗接种 的吸收,而仅靠 狂犬病 知识并不能独立预测 疫苗接种。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调,家庭层面的配置和行为模式在塑造 疫苗接种 结果方面发挥着关键作用,根据业主的意识和预防实践确定了不同的业主概况。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些集群在狗的种群结构、知识水平和 狂犬病 结果方面存在显着差异,强调需要量身定制的、情境敏感的 狂犬病 控制策略,将教育、以行为为中心的培训和结构支持结合起来。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 由于城市和乡村环境中养狗、管理实践和获得兽医服务的情况存在巨大差异,实现并维持建议的 70% 疫苗接种 覆盖率变得复杂。

title: Characterizing shelter intake, length of stay, and outcomes among free-ranging dogs in animal welfare organizations in India
abstract: Abstract Background- Countries in Global South carry the economic and social burden of unmanaged and understudied populations of free-ranging dogs globally. However, veterinary, shelter science and behaviour research fields are dominated by research from Global North countries and cater to a partial perspective. In this exploratory study, we try to bridge the gap of this divide by investigating the intake and outcome patterns of admitted free-ranging dogs in animal rescue organizations in India by analysing diverse data from over 24,000 records. We identify critical trends in admission causes, clinical burdens, and animal survival rates across from four geographically and institutionally distinct animal shelters in India between 2018 and 2022. Results- Average shelter intake volume grew by approximately 35% per year over the study period. Physical trauma emerged as the primary driver of admissions across all sites, regardless of regional differences in climate or urbanisation. While live outcomes generally exceeded non-live outcomes in most shelters, non-live outcomes (death and euthanasia) occurred at high rates (40–60%), substantially higher than reported Global North benchmarks. Survival was strongly associated with clinical presentation: neurological cases, most plausibly linked to endemic rabies and distemper, carried the poorest prognosis, with a median survival time of only one day. Systemic, gastrointestinal, and musculoskeletal conditions also carried significantly higher hazards for non-live outcomes. The overall median length of stay was 8 days, though hospitalization duration varied significantly, with oncological cases requiring the longest care. Conclusion- The findings characterise Indian shelters not as rehoming centres as a downstream safety net, for animal welfare crises originating from a lack of upstream population management, vaccination coverage, and injury prevention infrastructure. Furthermore, the study identifies the absence of standardised data collection as a fundamental barrier to evidence-based policy, highlighting an urgent need for shared data standards to improve animal welfare and public health outcomes across the Indian animal rescue sector. Ultimately, this study aims to provide a foundational evidence base and proof-of-concept for evaluating shelter science and canine welfare in Global South and other countries facing similar issues.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是一项探索性研究,分析了 2018 年至 2022 年间印度四个地理和机构不同的动物收容所的 24,000 多个记录的不同数据。研究设计包括审查入院原因、临床负担和存活率,但没有明确提及荟萃分析或共识过程。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该研究发现,无论气候或城市化的地区差异如何,身体创伤都是所有地点入院的主要驱动因素。它还报告说,非生命结果(死亡和安乐死)的发生率很高(40-60%),远高于报告的全球北方基准。此外,生存率与临床表现密切相关,神经系统病例可能与 狂犬病 和犬瘟热有关,预后最差,中位生存时间仅为一天。

Survival was strongly associated with clinical presentation: neurological cases, most plausibly linked to endemic rabies and distemper, carried the poorest prognosis, with a median survival time of only one day. Systemic, gastrointestinal, and musculoskeletal conditions also carried significantly higher hazards for non-live outcomes. The overall median length of stay was 8 days, though hospitalization duration varied significantly, with oncological cases requiring the longest care. Conclusion- The findings characterise Indian shelters not as rehoming centres as a downstream safety net, for animal welfare crises originating from a lack of upstream population management, vaccination coverage, and injury prevention infrastructure. Furthermore, the study identifies the absence of standardised data collection as a fundamental barrier to evidence-based policy, highlighting an urgent need for shared data standards to improve animal welfare and public health outcomes across the Indian animal rescue sector. Ultimately, this study aims to provide a foundational evidence base and proof-of-concept for evaluating shelter science and canine welfare in Global South and other countries facing similar issues.
abstract_zh: 摘要背景:全球南方国家承受着全球散养狗种群不受管理和研究不足的经济和社会负担。然而,兽医、住房科学和行为研究领域主要由北半球国家的研究主导,并且迎合了片面的观点。在这项探索性研究中,我们通过分析超过 24,000 条记录的不同数据,调查了印度动物救援组织接纳的自由放养狗的摄入量和结果模式,试图弥合这一差距。我们确定了 2018 年至 2022 年间印度四个地理位置和机构不同的动物收容所的入院原因、临床负担和动物存活率的关键趋势。结果 - 在研究期间,收容所的平均收容量每年增长约 35%。无论气候或城市化的地区差异如何,身体创伤都成为所有地点入院的主要驱动因素。虽然大多数庇护所的生命结果通常超过非生命结果,但非生命结果(死亡和安乐死)的发生率很高(40-60%),远高于报告的全球北方基准。生存与临床表现密切相关:神经系统病例,最有可能与地方性 狂犬病 和犬瘟热有关,预后最差,中位生存时间仅为一天。全身、胃肠道和肌肉骨骼疾病对非生命结果也具有显着更高的风险。总体中位住院时间为 8 天,但住院时间差异很大,其中肿瘤病例需要最长的护理。结论-研究结果表明,印度收容所并不是作为下游安全网的重新安置中心,因为动物福利危机源于缺乏上游种群管理、疫苗接种 覆盖范围和伤害预防基础设施。此外,该研究指出缺乏标准化数据收集是循证政策的根本障碍,强调迫切需要共享数据标准,以改善整个印度动物救援部门的动物福利和公共卫生结果。最终,这项研究旨在为评估南半球国家和其他面临类似问题的国家的收容所科学和犬类福利提供基础证据基础和概念验证。

title: Differential properties of gp120 from HIV-1 group M subtypes A and B
abstract: HIV-1 group M subtypes A and B differ substantially in their gp120 sequence. To determine whether these differences contribute to subtype-specific complications, particularly pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), rats were injected with gp120 from subtype A or B. Pulmonary artery (PA) remodeling was assessed after four weeks using hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining and the Vessel Morphometry Analysis tool by Autona (autona.org). Subtype A gp120 potently increased PA wall thickness and right ventricular hypertrophy. The CD4-binding region of subtype A lacks a stretch of 16 amino acids (V1 N-glycosylation site), and experiments showed stronger binding of subtype B to CD4. Subtype B gp120 contains an RGKV sequence, which resembles the RGKR sequence of the rabies virus glycoprotein G that binds to the nicotinic acetylcholine receptor (nAChR). Subtype A gp120 possesses a KDKK sequence instead. Molecular dynamics simulations indicated that both sites are surface-exposed. Although nAChR is expressed in PA cells and could potentially drive the pronounced effects of subtype A, MD simulations estimated that subtype B gp120 binds more strongly to nAChR. We also noted a single amino acid difference immediately preceding the REKR furin cleavage sequence: glutamate in subtype A versus glutamine in subtype B gp120. Simulations predicted that subtype A gp120 interacts more effectively with furin, and enzyme assays demonstrated that subtype A promotes a positive feedback loop more strongly than subtype B. Thus, HIV-1 gp120 subtype A is more potent in promoting PAH, and the mechanism may involve enhancing furin activity to elevate gp120 levels.

title: Visualization and Morphological Analysis of Individual Oligodendrocytes in the Mouse White Matter.
abstract: Myelin formation by oligodendrocytes is essential for the regulation of the conduction velocity and proper brain function. To ensure accurate information processing in response to experiences such as sensory stimuli and learning, oligodendrocytes adjust their number and morphology. In addition, oligodendrocyte morphology changes with senescence and in the presence of neurodegenerative diseases. Thus, visualizing oligodendrocytes and analyzing their morphology is crucial for understanding how our brains change under such conditions. Herein, we describe the methods for labeling and analyzing the morphologies of individual oligodendrocytes in mouse white matter at the light microscopic level. PDGFRa-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP and PLP-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP mice enable us to visualize and analyze later-born or early-born oligodendrocyte morphology. In addition, sparse oligodendrocyte labeling with attenuated rabies virus expressing GFP enables the visualization and morphological analysis of individual oligodendrocytes in various brain white matter regions without the need for transgenic animals. Furthermore, the combination with immunostaining in thick tissues enables the identification of labeled oligodendrocytes and myelin sheaths, as well as their interactions with neuronal axons. These methods are suitable for revealing how oligodendrocytes adapt their morphologies depending on environmental stimuli or pathological conditions.

abstract_zh: 少突胶质细胞形成髓鞘对于调节传导速度和维持正常脑功能至关重要。为了确保对如感觉刺激和学习等经验的准确信息处理,少突胶质细胞会调整其数量和形态。此外,少突胶质细胞的形态也会随着衰老和神经退行性疾病的发生而发生变化。因此,对少突胶质细胞进行可视化和形态学分析对于理解我们的大脑在这些条件下的变化至关重要。本文描述了在光学显微镜水平上对小鼠白质中单个少突胶质细胞进行标记和形态学分析的方法。PDGFRa-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP和PLP-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP小鼠使我们能够可视化和分析晚期出生或早期出生的少突胶质细胞的形态。此外,使用减弱的狂犬病病毒表达GFP的稀疏少突胶质细胞标记方法,可以在无需转基因动物的情况下,对各种脑白质区域中的单个少突胶质细胞进行可视化和形态学分析。此外,与厚组织免疫染色相结合,可以识别标记的少突胶质细胞和髓鞘,以及它们与神经元轴突的相互作用。这些方法适用于揭示少突胶质细胞如何根据环境刺激或病理条件调整其形态。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及使用 PDGFRa-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP 和 PLP-CreERT2:Tau-mGFP 小鼠来可视化和分析晚生或早生的少突胶质细胞形态。用表达 GFP 的减毒 狂犬病病毒 标记稀疏少突胶质细胞,无需转基因动物即可对各个脑白质区域中的单个少突胶质细胞进行可视化和形态学分析。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法包括使用表达 GFP 的减毒 狂犬病病毒 标记单个少突胶质细胞,并将其与厚组织中的免疫染色相结合,以识别标记的少突胶质细胞和髓鞘,以及它们与神经元轴突的相互作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该研究直接观察了在光学显微镜水平上可视化和分析小鼠白质中单个少突胶质细胞形态的能力。

analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以帮助理解少突胶质细胞如何适应其形态以响应环境刺激或病理条件,这可能对神经科学研究和神经系统疾病的研究产生影响。

title: Summary of the National Advisory Committee on Immunization (NACI) Statement: Updated guidance for use of rabies vaccine for pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP)
abstract: Background: Rabies is a rare but almost universally fatal disease.While treatment is ineffective once symptoms develop, infection can be prevented through timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP).Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) is recommended for people at risk of rabies exposure.While PrEP generally simplifies PEP, it does not replace the need for PEP.The National Advisory Committee on Immunization (NACI) updated its PrEP guidance following a review of recent evidence.Objective: To summarize NACI's updated recommendations on rabies PrEP, including risk groups, vaccination schedules, routes of administration, serologic testing, product interchangeability and PEP guidance for previously vaccinated individuals.Methods: NACI used an evidence-to-recommendation framework, including a systematic review of immunogenicity by number of doses (one, two or three) and route of administration (one-site intramuscular [IM] vs two-site intradermal [ID]).These recommendations were reviewed and approved by NACI based on the available evidence.Results: NACI re-defined PrEP risk categories into very high, high and moderate risk.For most groups, a three-dose schedule (which includes two doses plus a booster/third dose) is recommended.For non-immunocompromised individuals in the moderate risk group with risk lasting less than three years, a two-dose schedule is recommended.Both one-site IM and twosite ID routes are acceptable.Serologic testing recommendations are provided by risk group, and routine serology solely because PrEP was administered by the two-site ID route is not recommended.Vaccine products and routes of administration are considered interchangeable when necessary.The importance of PEP, including for those who have previously received PrEP, is emphasized, and guidance provided for those who have received one or more prior rabies vaccine doses.Conclusion: Updated NACI guidance reduces doses for some groups and increases flexibility in administration while maintaining protection.NACI will continue to monitor evidence and update recommendations as needed.The full NACI guidance is available in the NACI statement entitled Updated Guidance for Use of Rabies Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP) and is also summarized in the Rabies vaccines chapter of the Canadian Immunization Guide.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on rabies virus and rabies disease. The central question is to summarize the updated NACI guidance on rabies pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP), including risk groups, vaccination schedules, routes of administration, serologic testing, product interchangeability, and PEP guidance for previously vaccinated individuals.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: NACI used an evidence-to-recommendation framework, including a systematic review of immunogenicity by number of doses (one, two or three) and route of administration (one-site intramuscular [IM] vs two-site intradermal [ID]). These recommendations were reviewed and approved by NACI based on the available evidence.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: NACI re-defined PrEP risk categories into very high, high and moderate risk. For most groups, a three-dose schedule (which includes two doses plus a booster/third dose) is recommended. For non-immunocompromised individuals in the moderate risk group with risk lasting less than three years, a two-dose schedule is recommended. Both one-site IM and two-site ID routes are acceptable. Vaccine products and routes of administration are considered interchangeable when necessary. The importance of PEP, including for those who have previously received PrEP, is emphasized, and guidance is provided for those who have received one or more prior rabies vaccine doses.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The supplied evidence does not report controversies or evidence gaps.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The supplied evidence does not report specific priorities for research, surveillance, diagnosis, treatment, vaccination, ecology, risk assessment or policy.

analysis.summary_en: This review summarizes the updated guidance from the National Advisory Committee on Immunization (NACI) on the use of rabies vaccine for pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP). The review outlines the redefined risk categories for PrEP, recommending a three-dose schedule for most groups and a two-dose schedule for non-immunocompromised individuals in the moderate risk group with risk lasting less than three years. Both one-site intramuscular (IM) and two-site intradermal (ID) routes of administration are considered acceptable. The review emphasizes the importance of post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP) for those who have previously received PrEP and provides guidance for individuals who have received one or more prior rabies vaccine doses. The recommendations are based on a systematic review of immunogenicity and were approved by NACI. The full guidance is available in the NACI statement and the Canadian Immunization Guide.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述重点关注 狂犬病病毒 和 狂犬病 疾病。核心问题是总结更新的 NACI 关于 狂犬病 暴露前预防 (PrEP) 的指南,包括风险群体、狂犬病 时间表、给药途径、血清学检测、产品互换性以及针对先前接种疫苗的个体的 PEP 指南。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: NACI 使用了从证据到推荐的框架,包括通过剂量数量(一剂、两剂或三剂)和给药途径(单部位肌肉注射 [IM] 与两部位皮内注射 [ID])对免疫原性进行系统评价。这些建议由 NACI 根据现有证据进行审查和批准。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: NACI 将 PrEP 风险类别重新定义为极高、高和中等风险。对于大多数群体,建议采用三剂方案(包括两剂加加强剂/第三剂)。对于风险持续不到三年的中度风险组中非免疫功能低下的个体,建议采用两剂方案。单站点 IM 和双站点 ID 路由均可接受。疫苗 产品和给药途径在必要时被认为是可以互换的。强调了 PEP 的重要性,包括对于那些之前接受过 PrEP 的人,并为那些之前接受过一剂或多剂 狂犬病 疫苗 剂量的人提供了指导。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 所提供的证据不报告争议或证据差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 所提供的证据未报告研究、监测、诊断、治疗、疫苗接种、生态、风险评估或政策的具体优先事项。

title_zh: 国家免疫咨询委员会 (NACI) 声明摘要:使用 狂犬病 疫苗 进行暴露前预防 (PrEP) 的更新指南
source_body_en: Background: Rabies is a rare but almost universally fatal disease.While treatment is ineffective once symptoms develop, infection can be prevented through timely post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP).Pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) is recommended for people at risk of rabies exposure.While PrEP generally simplifies PEP, it does not replace the need for PEP.The National Advisory Committee on Immunization (NACI) updated its PrEP guidance following a review of recent evidence.Objective: To summarize NACI's updated recommendations on rabies PrEP, including risk groups, vaccination schedules, routes of administration, serologic testing, product interchangeability and PEP guidance for previously vaccinated individuals.Methods: NACI used an evidence-to-recommendation framework, including a systematic review of immunogenicity by number of doses (one, two or three) and route of administration (one-site intramuscular [IM] vs two-site intradermal [ID]).These recommendations were reviewed and approved by NACI based on the available evidence.Results: NACI re-defined PrEP risk categories into very high, high and moderate risk.For most groups, a three-dose schedule (which includes two doses plus a booster/third dose) is recommended.For non-immunocompromised individuals in the moderate risk group with risk lasting less than three years, a two-dose schedule is recommended.Both one-site IM and twosite ID routes are acceptable.Serologic testing recommendations are provided by risk group, and routine serology solely because PrEP was administered by the two-site ID route is not recommended.Vaccine products and routes of administration are considered interchangeable when necessary.The importance of PEP, including for those who have previously received PrEP, is emphasized, and guidance provided for those who have received one or more prior rabies vaccine doses.Conclusion: Updated NACI guidance reduces doses for some groups and increases flexibility in administration while maintaining protection.NACI will continue to monitor evidence and update recommendations as needed.The full NACI guidance is available in the NACI statement entitled Updated Guidance for Use of Rabies Pre-Exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP) and is also summarized in the Rabies vaccines chapter of the Canadian Immunization Guide.
abstract_zh: 背景:狂犬病 是一种罕见但几乎普遍致命的疾病。虽然 治疗 一旦出现症状就无效,但可以通过及时的 暴露后预防 (PEP) 来预防感染。建议有 狂犬病 暴露风险的人进行暴露前预防 (PrEP)。虽然 PrEP 通常简化了 PEP,但它并不能取代 PEP 的需要。国家免疫咨询委员会(NACI) 在审查最新证据后更新了其 PrEP 指南。目的:总结 NACI 关于 狂犬病 PrEP 的更新建议,包括风险群体、疫苗接种 时间表、给药途径、血清学测试、产品互换性和针对先前接种过疫苗的个体的 PEP 指南。方法:NACI 使用证据到推荐框架,包括按剂量数量(一剂、两剂或三剂)和途径对免疫原性进行系统审查给药方案(单部位肌肉注射 [IM] 与两部位皮内注射 [ID])。这些建议由 NACI 根据现有证据进行审查和批准。结果:NACI 将 PrEP 风险类别重新定义为极高、高和中等风险。对于大多数组,建议采用三剂方案(包括两剂加加强剂/第三剂)。对于风险持续不到三年的中度风险组中非免疫功能低下的个体,采用两剂方案建议使用单位点 IM 和双位点 ID 途径。血清学检测建议由风险组提供,并且不建议仅因为 PrEP 是通过双位点 ID 途径进行常规 血清学。疫苗 产品和给药途径在必要时被认为是可以互换的。强调 PEP 的重要性,包括对于那些以前接受过 PrEP 的人,并为那些先前接受过一项或多项 狂犬病 的人提供指导疫苗 剂量。结论:更新的 NACI 指南减少了某些群体的剂量,并在保持保护的同时增加了给药的灵活性。NACI 将继续监测证据并根据需要更新建议。完整的 NACI 指南可在题为“使用 狂犬病 暴露前预防 (PrEP) 的更新指南”的 NACI 声明中找到,并且也在加拿大的 狂犬病 疫苗 章节中进行了总结。免疫指南。

title: Vaccine-associated Guillain–Barré Syndrome Following Purified Chick Embryo Cell Antirabies Vaccination: A Demyelinating Phenotype with Anti-GM1 IgG Antibodies
abstract: Objective To report severe demyelinating GBS variant with anti-GM1 IgG antibodies following purified chick embryo cell (PCEC) antirabies vaccination, highlighting the need for vigilance in post-vaccination neurological decline. Background Vaccine-associated GBS is rare but recognized, historically linked to older neural-tissue rabies vaccines. Newer PCEC vaccines are considered safer; however, recent large-scale data suggest a statistically significant association with GBS, warranting re-evaluation of post-vaccination surveillance thresholds. Design/Methods Single-patient observational report with clinical, biochemical, cerebrospinal fluid, electrodiagnostic, antibody, and radiologic correlation with follow-up at 3 months Results A 25-year-old woman developed descending sensorimotor weakness, facial diplegia, bulbar dysfunction, and autonomic involvement — including urinary retention — three days after the third dose of PCEC antirabies vaccine administered following a monkey bite. No antecedent respiratory or gastrointestinal infection was identified. CSF demonstrated albuminocytologic dissociation (protein 283 mg/dL, normal cell count). Neurotropic virus panel was negative. Anti-GM1 IgG antibodies were detected — an antibody classically associated with axonal variants but identified here in a demyelinating phenotype. Nerve conduction studies showed prominent conduction block, prolonged distal latencies, slowed conduction velocities, and temporal dispersion in median and peroneal nerves, consistent with severe acquired demyelinating polyneuropathy. Respiratory compromise necessitated mechanical ventilation. Following seven sessions of plasmapheresis (40 mL/kg/session), the patient was extubated at day 7. Limb power improved to MRC 4/5. Repeat NCS at 4 weeks showed resolution of conduction block with partial normalization of distal latencies. At 3-month follow-up, full limb power was restored with only mild residual facial weakness. Conclusions This case demonstrates that PCEC antirabies vaccination can be associated with severe demyelinating GBS with atypical anti-GM1 IgG seropositivity. The descending pattern of weakness risks misdiagnosis — with botulism, diphtheria, and acute intermittent porphyria in the differential. A low threshold for early electrodiagnostic evaluation and plasmapheresis initiation is critical. As rabies vaccination expands globally, post-vaccination neurological surveillance protocols require strengthening.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在报告纯化鸡胚细胞 (PCEC) 抗狂犬病 疫苗接种 后出现严重脱髓鞘性格林-巴利综合征 (GBS) 变异,并伴有抗 GM1 IgG 抗体,强调需要对 疫苗接种 后神经功能衰退保持警惕。这很重要,因为与 疫苗 相关的 GBS 很少见,但已得到认可,历史上与较旧的神经组织 狂犬病 疫苗 有关。

title_zh: 纯化鸡胚胎细胞抗狂犬病后的 疫苗 相关吉兰-巴利综合征 疫苗接种:抗 GM1 IgG 抗体的脱髓鞘表型
source_body_en: Objective To report severe demyelinating GBS variant with anti-GM1 IgG antibodies following purified chick embryo cell (PCEC) antirabies vaccination, highlighting the need for vigilance in post-vaccination neurological decline. Background Vaccine-associated GBS is rare but recognized, historically linked to older neural-tissue rabies vaccines. Newer PCEC vaccines are considered safer; however, recent large-scale data suggest a statistically significant association with GBS, warranting re-evaluation of post-vaccination surveillance thresholds. Design/Methods Single-patient observational report with clinical, biochemical, cerebrospinal fluid, electrodiagnostic, antibody, and radiologic correlation with follow-up at 3 months Results A 25-year-old woman developed descending sensorimotor weakness, facial diplegia, bulbar dysfunction, and autonomic involvement — including urinary retention — three days after the third dose of PCEC antirabies vaccine administered following a monkey bite. No antecedent respiratory or gastrointestinal infection was identified. CSF demonstrated albuminocytologic dissociation (protein 283 mg/dL, normal cell count). Neurotropic virus panel was negative. Anti-GM1 IgG antibodies were detected — an antibody classically associated with axonal variants but identified here in a demyelinating phenotype. Nerve conduction studies showed prominent conduction block, prolonged distal latencies, slowed conduction velocities, and temporal dispersion in median and peroneal nerves, consistent with severe acquired demyelinating polyneuropathy. Respiratory compromise necessitated mechanical ventilation. Following seven sessions of plasmapheresis (40 mL/kg/session), the patient was extubated at day 7. Limb power improved to MRC 4/5. Repeat NCS at 4 weeks showed resolution of conduction block with partial normalization of distal latencies. At 3-month follow-up, full limb power was restored with only mild residual facial weakness. Conclusions This case demonstrates that PCEC antirabies vaccination can be associated with severe demyelinating GBS with atypical anti-GM1 IgG seropositivity. The descending pattern of weakness risks misdiagnosis — with botulism, diphtheria, and acute intermittent porphyria in the differential. A low threshold for early electrodiagnostic evaluation and plasmapheresis initiation is critical. As rabies vaccination expands globally, post-vaccination neurological surveillance protocols require strengthening.
abstract_zh: 目的 报告纯化鸡胚细胞 (PCEC) 抗狂犬病 疫苗接种 后出现严重脱髓鞘 GBS 变异,并伴有抗 GM1 IgG 抗体,强调需要对 疫苗接种 后神经功能衰退保持警惕。背景 疫苗 相关的 GBS 很少见,但已得到认可,历史上与较旧的神经组织 狂犬病 疫苗 有关。较新的 PCEC 疫苗 被认为更安全;然而,最近的大规模数据表明与 GBS 存在统计学上的显着关联,因此需要重新评估 疫苗接种 后的 监测 阈值。设计/方法 单患者观察报告,包括临床、生化、脑脊液、电诊断、抗体和放射学与 3 个月随访的相关性 结果 一名 25 岁女性在被猴子咬伤后服用第三剂 PCEC 抗狂犬病 疫苗 后三天,出现感觉运动下降无力、面部瘫痪、延髓功能障碍和自主神经受累(包括尿潴留)。未发现既往呼吸道或胃肠道感染。CSF 显示蛋白细胞解离(蛋白质 283 mg/dL,细胞计数正常)。嗜神经病毒组呈阴性。检测到了抗 GM1 IgG 抗体,这种抗体通常与轴突变体相关,但在此发现为脱髓鞘表型。神经传导研究显示正中神经和腓神经有明显的传导阻滞、远端潜伏期延长、传导速度减慢和时间分散,与严重的获得性脱髓鞘性多发性神经病一致。呼吸系统受损需要机械通气。经过 7 次血浆置换(40 mL/kg/次)后,患者在第 7 天拔管。肢体力量改善至 MRC 4/5。4 周时重复 NCS 显示传导阻滞得到缓解,远端潜伏期部分正常化。3 个月随访时,肢体力量全部恢复,仅残留轻微面部无力。结论 该病例表明 PCEC 抗狂犬病 疫苗接种 可能与非典型抗 GM1 IgG 血清阳性的严重脱髓鞘 GBS 相关。无力的下降模式有误诊的风险——需要鉴别肉毒杆菌中毒、白喉和急性间歇性卟啉症。早期电诊断评估和血浆置换启动的低阈值至关重要。随着 狂犬病 疫苗接种 在全球范围内的扩张,后 疫苗接种 神经学 监测 协议需要加强。

title: Divergent spike protein with a remodeled receptor-binding interface in an unclassified bat-associated alphacoronavirus from Brazil
abstract: Abstract Background Bats harbor the greatest known diversity of alphacoronaviruses (alphaCoVs), yet this diversity remains poorly sampled in the Neotropics. Characterizing divergent bat-associated alphaCoVs is central to understanding coronavirus (CoV) evolution, Spike protein diversification, and the molecular basis of host adaptation. We characterized the virome profiles of samples from Brazilian bats and jaguars, identified previously undescribed bat-associated alphaCoVs, and modeled the Spike protein of one unclassified alphaCoV for which a complete Spike gene was recovered. Methods Individual samples were first screened for CoVs using a pan-CoVs PCR assay, and for influenza A virus (IAV) and rabies virus (RABV). CoV amplicons were subsequently sequenced using the Sanger method. Samples were then pooled, and metatranscriptomic sequencing was performed on bat tissues ( Molossus molossus and Uroderma bilobatum ) and whole-blood samples from jaguar ( Panthera onca ). Viral contigs were assembled, manually curated, and analyzed using maximum-likelihood and Bayesian phylogenetic inference, nucleotide similarity profiling, and recombination screening. The complete Spike protein was modeled with AlphaFold3 and compared with experimentally determined alphaCoV Spike structures by structural superposition, electrostatic surface mapping, and prediction of complexes with the human receptors angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) and aminopeptidase N (APN). All inferences are based on sequence and structural analysis; no virus isolation, receptor-binding assay or cell-entry experiment was performed. Results AlphaCoV sequences were detected in M. bilobatum bats, from which 13 partial alphaCoV contigs were recovered and analyzed individually. Phylogenetic analyses placed most of these sequences within divergent bat-associated alphaCoV clades that could not be assigned to any recognized ICTV species or subgenus; one short gastrointestinal tract-derived sequence from U. bilobatum instead clustered within the clade corresponding to the recognized subgenus Amalacovirus. The recovered Spike gene was highly divergent from all characterized alphaCoVs, with no evidence of recent recombination. Despite this divergence, the predicted Spike structure retained the overall receptor-binding domain (RBD) fold, while exhibiting extensive remodeling of the receptor-binding motif and of surface electrostatic properties. AlphaFold3 predicted sterically compatible complexes with both ACE2 and APN, but the predicted interfaces were formed by residue sets and geometries distinct from those of experimentally determined human alphaCoV complexes. Non-CoV sequences recovered from jaguar whole blood were reported as taxonomic matches of uncertain provenance; they do not establish infection, and the absence of CoV sequences in blood does not establish that these animals were uninfected. Conclusions These findings extend the known diversity of bat-associated alphaCoVs in Brazil and identify sequences that could not be assigned to any recognized subgenus of the genus Alphacoronavirus. The conservation of the RBD fold, despite extensive remodeling of the receptor-binding interface, is consistent with a model in which the receptor-binding surface of alphaCoVs can diversify while the underlying structural scaffold is retained. Because the structural analyses are entirely computational, they generate hypotheses for experimental testing rather than evidence of human receptor usage. Overall, these findings provide new insights into alphaCoV evolution and offer a framework for investigating how extensive remodeling of the Spike receptor-binding interface can occur while preserving the underlying structural scaffold.
authors: Bruna Stefanie Silvério de Lima Slobosk

abstract_zh: 摘要背景 蝙蝠拥有已知最丰富的α冠状病毒(alphaCoV)多样性,但这种多样性在新热带地区的样本仍然很少。表征不同的蝙蝠相关 alphaCoV 是了解冠状病毒 (CoV) 进化、刺突蛋白多样性以及 宿主 适应的分子基础的核心。我们对巴西蝙蝠和美洲虎样本的病毒组特征进行了表征,鉴定了之前未描述的与蝙蝠相关的 alphaCoV,并对一种未分类的 alphaCoV 的 Spike 蛋白进行了建模,并为其恢复了完整的 Spike 基因。方法 首先使用泛冠状病毒 PCR 检测对个体样本进行冠状病毒筛查,以及甲型流感病毒 (IAV) 和 狂犬病病毒 (RABV)。随后使用 Sanger 方法对 CoV 扩增子进行测序。然后汇集样本,并对蝙蝠组织(Molossus molossus 和 Uroderma bilobatum)和美洲虎(Panthera onca)的全血样本进行宏转录组测序。使用最大似然和贝叶斯系统发育推断、核苷酸相似性分析和重组筛选来组装、手动策划和分析病毒重叠群。使用 AlphaFold3 对完整的 Spike 蛋白进行建模,并通过结构叠加、静电表面绘图以及预测与人类受体血管紧张素转换酶 2 (ACE2) 和氨肽酶 N (APN) 的复合物,与实验确定的 alphaCoV Spike 结构进行比较。所有推论均基于序列和结构分析;未进行病毒分离、受体结合测定或细胞进入实验。结果 在 M. bilobatum 蝙蝠中检测到 AlphaCoV 序列,从中回收并单独分析了 13 个部分 alphaCoV 重叠群。系统发育分析将大多数这些序列置于不同的蝙蝠相关 alphaCoV 进化枝内,这些进化枝无法归属于任何公认的 ICTV 物种或亚属;相反,来自 U. bilobatum 的一段来自胃肠道的短序列聚集在与公认的 Amalacovirus 亚属相对应的进化枝内。回收的 Spike 基因与所有已表征的 alphaCoV 都高度不同,没有近期重组的证据。尽管存在这种差异,预测的刺突结构保留了整体受体结合结构域(RBD)折叠,同时表现出受体结合基序和表面静电特性的广泛重塑。AlphaFold3 预测了与 ACE2 和 APN 空间相容的复合物,但预测的界面是由与实验确定的人类 alphaCoV 复合物不同的残基集和几何形状形成的。据报道,从美洲虎全血中回收的非 CoV 序列与来源不确定的分类学匹配;它们没有建立感染,并且血液中没有冠状病毒序列并不能证明这些动物没有被感染。结论 这些发现扩展了巴西蝙蝠相关 αCoV 的已知多样性,并鉴定了无法归属于任何公认的 Alpha 冠状病毒属亚属的序列。尽管受体结合界面进行了广泛的重塑,但 RBD 折叠的保守性与 alphaCoV 的受体结合表面可以多样化而底层结构支架得以保留的模型是一致的。由于结构分析完全是计算性的,因此它们生成用于实验测试的假设,而不是人类受体使用的证据。总的来说,这些发现为 alphaCoV 进化 提供了新的见解,并为研究如何在保留底层结构支架的同时对 Spike 受体结合界面进行广泛的重塑提供了一个框架。

title: First detection of canine distemper virus infection in varie¬gated squirrels (Sciurus variegatoides) and porcupines (Coendou mexicanus) in Costa Rica
abstract: Canine distemper virus (CDV) is a multi-host pathogen capable of infecting a wide range of do-mestic and wild mammals, however, reports of infection in squirrels and porcupines remain scarce. As part of the wildlife rabies surveillance programme in Costa Rica, six wild mammals (four Sciurus variegatoides and two Coendou mexicanus) with neurological signs were evaluated to rule out rabies. All brain samples tested negative for rabies by direct immunofluorescence and RT-PCR. Rapid distemper antigen tests of ocular and nasal secretions were positive in both porcupines, which were subsequently euthanised. Advanced autolysis prevented histopathological evaluation in five of the animals; however, one squirrel showed severe neutrophilic pneumonia with necrosis and haemorrhage, a moderate lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate in the pulmonary interstitium, intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies in bronchial epithelium, and a focal neutrophilic infiltrate in the midbrain. The findings were consistent with CDV infection accompanied by severe systemic bacterial infection. CDV was confirmed in two of the four squirrels and in the two porcupines by RT-PCR and sequencing. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that the Costa Rican sequences grouped into two distinct clusters: one containing both squirrels and another with both porcupines. All four sequences shared a common ancestor with CDV strains detected in domestic dogs in the United States (2012–2013), and more distantly with a dog strain from Argentina (2005). These cases represent one of the few documented occurrences of CDV in squirrels and porcupines worldwide and the first reported in Costa Rica, underscoring the need for continued molecular surveillance to clarify lineage dynamics and spillover pathways.

Six wild mammals with neurological signs were evaluated as part of a rabies surveillance program. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 犬瘟热病毒(CDV)是一种多宿主病原体,能够感染多种家养和野生动物,然而,关于其在松鼠和豪猪中的感染报告仍然很少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 作为哥斯达黎加野生动物监测项目的一部分,对六只表现出神经系统症状的野生哺乳动物(四只Sciurus variegatoides和两只Coendou mexicanus)进行了评估以排除某种病原体。
elements_zh.methods: 所有脑组织样本通过直接免疫荧光和RT-PCR检测均未发现该病原体。通过RT-PCR和测序确认了其中两只松鼠和两只豪猪感染了CDV。
elements_zh.main_results: 对豪猪的结膜液和鼻分泌物进行的快速犬瘟热抗原检测呈阳性,随后这些豪猪被安乐死。五只动物因严重的自溶作用而无法进行组织病理学评估;然而,一只松鼠表现出严重的中性粒细胞性肺炎伴有坏死和出血,肺间质中有中度的淋巴浆细胞浸润,支气管上皮细胞中有胞浆内包涵体,中脑区域有局灶性中性粒细胞性浸润。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现与CDV感染伴随严重的系统性细菌感染一致。这些病例是全球少数记录的CDV在松鼠和豪猪中的感染案例之一,也是哥斯达黎加首次报告,强调了继续进行分子监测以明确病毒谱系动态和传播途径的重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现突显了分子监测在理解CDV谱系动态和传播途径中的重要性,这可以为疾病预防和控制的公共卫生策略提供信息。

title_zh: 哥斯达黎加首次检测到犬瘟热病毒在斑纹松鼠(Sciurus variegatoides)和豪猪(Coendou mexicanus)中的感染
source_body_en: Canine distemper virus (CDV) is a multi-host pathogen capable of infecting a wide range of do-mestic and wild mammals, however, reports of infection in squirrels and porcupines remain scarce. As part of the wildlife rabies surveillance programme in Costa Rica, six wild mammals (four Sciurus variegatoides and two Coendou mexicanus) with neurological signs were evaluated to rule out rabies. All brain samples tested negative for rabies by direct immunofluorescence and RT-PCR. Rapid distemper antigen tests of ocular and nasal secretions were positive in both porcupines, which were subsequently euthanised. Advanced autolysis prevented histopathological evaluation in five of the animals; however, one squirrel showed severe neutrophilic pneumonia with necrosis and haemorrhage, a moderate lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate in the pulmonary interstitium, intracytoplasmic inclusion bodies in bronchial epithelium, and a focal neutrophilic infiltrate in the midbrain. The findings were consistent with CDV infection accompanied by severe systemic bacterial infection. CDV was confirmed in two of the four squirrels and in the two porcupines by RT-PCR and sequencing. Phylogenetic analysis revealed that the Costa Rican sequences grouped into two distinct clusters: one containing both squirrels and another with both porcupines. All four sequences shared a common ancestor with CDV strains detected in domestic dogs in the United States (2012–2013), and more distantly with a dog strain from Argentina (2005). These cases represent one of the few documented occurrences of CDV in squirrels and porcupines worldwide and the first reported in Costa Rica, underscoring the need for continued molecular surveillance to clarify lineage dynamics and spillover pathways.
abstract_zh: 犬瘟热病毒(CDV)是一种多宿主病原体,能够感染多种家养和野生动物,然而,关于其在松鼠和豪猪中的感染报告仍然很少。作为哥斯达黎加野生动物监测项目的一部分,对六只表现出神经系统症状的野生哺乳动物(四只Sciurus variegatoides和两只Coendou mexicanus)进行了评估以排除某种病原体。所有脑组织样本通过直接免疫荧光和RT-PCR检测均未发现该病原体。对豪猪的结膜液和鼻分泌物进行的快速犬瘟热抗原检测呈阳性,随后这些豪猪被安乐死。五只动物因严重的自溶作用而无法进行组织病理学评估;然而,一只松鼠表现出严重的中性粒细胞性肺炎伴有坏死和出血,肺间质中有中度的淋巴浆细胞浸润,支气管上皮细胞中有胞浆内包涵体,中脑区域有局灶性中性粒细胞性浸润。这些发现与CDV感染伴随严重的系统性细菌感染一致。通过RT-PCR和测序确认了其中两只松鼠和两只豪猪感染了CDV。系统发育分析显示,哥斯达黎加的序列分为两个不同的簇:一个簇包含松鼠,另一个簇包含豪猪。所有四个序列都与美国2012–2013年检测到的犬瘟热病毒株有共同祖先,并且与阿根廷2005年检测到的犬瘟热病毒株有较远的亲缘关系。这些病例是全球少数记录的CDV在松鼠和豪猪中的感染案例之一,也是哥斯达黎加首次报告,强调了继续进行分子监测以明确病毒谱系动态和传播途径的重要性。

title: A Disease-Agnostic Data Model and Pluggable Module Interface for Spatio-Temporal Risk Analytics: An Open Reference Implementation Evaluated on Veterinary Surveillance Data
abstract: Spatio-temporal risk analytics for animal-health surveillance relies on established methods—maximum entropy (MaxEnt) suitability modeling, space–time scan statistics, principal component analysis (PCA), and Bayesian prevalence estimation—usually run as isolated, disease-specific workflows. This paper presents a disease-agnostic event schema and a typed plug-in interface, with an open-source Python reference implementation. The full registry-ingestion and modeling workflow was tested with raw anthrax and rabies registries containing 4183 and 363 georeferenced records, respectively. The PCA and Bayesian components, however, used aggregates reconstructed from earlier publications, so those tests assessed interface conformance and numerical reproduction rather than independent validation. With the same inputs, the scan component reproduced the primary SaTScan clusters, yielding Jaccard indices of 0.91 and 1.00, although it matched 8 of 13 significant anthrax clusters overall. Spatial block cross-validation produced produced area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) values values of 0.74–0.77 for anthrax, compared with 0.67–0.70 for the elapid MaxEnt implementation; the exact figures depended on fold assignment and regularization. The roughly two-orders-of-magnitude runtime gap also applies only to those particular implementations, feature sets, and datasets. Adding a fifth disease required a single 37-line source loader, with no edits to the 1034 lines of shared code. These results show that the system can run on one workstation, but database-backed deployment, operational scaling, and prospective forecasting were not tested.
